exception.impl: The implementation used cannot create MaxExtZoomControl controls

textHelp.title: MAXEXTZOOM
textHelp.paragraph1: This plugin adds a button that fits the map view to the maximum extent defined by the viewer (loaded layers, WMC or default bounding box) in a single click.
textHelp.screenshot1Alt: Map with the zoom-to-extent control visible on the viewer toolbar
textHelp.screenshot1Description: Find the control icon (usually in a corner depending on position); the tooltip reads “Zoom to the map extent”.
